# Launcher artwork

## Project logo — Pabl06

launcher-logo.png is the unmodified YW4PlusPlus_Recomp_Logo.png supplied by
the project owner, by **Pabl06**. The launcher header also credits Pabl06.
launcher-logo.bmp is a resized, premultiplied-alpha conversion for the native
Windows header, generated by scripts/make-launcher-logo.py.
Attribution does not assign a license to this logo or grant rights to underlying
LEVEL-5 artwork and trademarks; it is not covered by the source-code license.

## Application icons

`launcher-normal.png` and `launcher-dlc.png` were supplied by hxgohxrr for this
launcher and its public source distribution, and described by the provider as
hand-drawn redraws. The corresponding ICO files are format conversions made with
`scripts/make-launcher-icons.py` (Pillow).

The project's GPL-3.0-or-later applies to the provider's original contributions.
This records the provider's description, not independent verification of the
artwork's origin or clearance of third-party rights. Game names, marks and any
underlying third-party material remain subject to their respective rights.

Wimsy resources remain separately credited to Liz under GPL-3.0-or-later.
